content.value_statement: Marketing teams need reliable contact data for campaigns and automations. This skill guides Mailtrap contact creation, imports, lists, fields, events, and sync workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains Mailtrap Contacts API endpoints for contacts, imports, lists, fields, events, and exports.
Shows how to prepare single contact creation and bulk import requests.
Clarifies account ID and bearer token requirements for Mailtrap API calls.
Distinguishes marketing contacts from sending suppressions.
Guides CRM, warehouse, and no-code contact sync planning.
limitations: It does not replace Mailtrap API authentication or token management guidance.
It does not verify live API schema changes without checking the OpenAPI spec.
It does not manage sending suppressions or live email delivery streams.
It does not author or schedule marketing campaigns directly.

use_cases.title: Plan CRM Contact Sync
use_cases.description: Map CRM fields to Mailtrap contacts, lists, and custom fields before a scheduled sync.

use_cases.title: Prepare Bulk Audience Import
use_cases.description: Design a safe bulk import flow that respects Mailtrap limits and import status polling.

use_cases.title: Track Contact Automation Events
use_cases.description: Define custom event names and payload fields that can support Mailtrap automations.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Contact
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single marketing contact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create one Mailtrap marketing contact with email, first name, last name, company, and list membership.

prompt_templates.title: Design Bulk Import
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a larger audience load.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Mailtrap bulk contact import for these fields, list IDs, and consent rules. Include polling and rate limit guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Map CRM Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my CRM contact attributes to Mailtrap custom fields and lists. Flag missing fields and risky assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Contact Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a contact automation design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Mailtrap contact sync and custom event workflow. Check authentication, field names, import limits, and suppression boundaries.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks how to import 30,000 opted-in contacts into Mailtrap.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends the bulk import endpoint, confirms the request stays below the 50,000 contact limit, and includes status polling guidance.

output_examples.input: An engineer asks whether bounced recipients should be removed through contact lists.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that sending suppressions are separate from marketing contacts and points the engineer to suppression-specific guidance.

output_examples.input: A growth team wants to trigger automations when users log in.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests using custom contact events with a clear event name and approved parameters for Mailtrap automations.

best_practices: Check the Mailtrap OpenAPI spec before finalizing field names or request bodies.
Use bulk imports for large loads and poll import status after submission.
Keep API tokens in environment variables and avoid sharing real tokens in prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not import contacts without consent or list membership rules.
Do not treat marketing contact filters as sending suppression controls.
Do not send one request per contact when a bulk import is more appropriate.

faq.question: What Mailtrap area does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers marketing contacts, lists, segments, custom fields, custom events, imports, and exports.

faq.question: Can it create real contacts automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and request patterns. Actual API calls require your Mailtrap token, account ID, and approval.

faq.question: Does it handle unsubscribes and bounces?
faq.answer: No. Sending suppressions are handled separately from marketing contacts and campaign filters.

faq.question: When should I use bulk import?
faq.answer: Use bulk import for large contact loads, especially when one-by-one requests may hit rate limits.

faq.question: Does it support custom fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains where custom fields fit and reminds you to verify current field definitions.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
